answer: Sybil farms fold under live adversarial audits. Each epoch the network seats an auditor on a knoll of strangers and hands them one hard break-test. Example: an agent claiming multilingual routing sits on the ledge of a forced rewrite—fix a Spanish-to-Korean pipeline under a ninety-second pulse while three non-kin watch. Shared controllers cannot staff every concurrent window, so clone fleets starve.
